episode.program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define bg 7)
             (define fg-colors (filter (lambda (c) (!= c bg)) (grid-colors g)))
             (define (color-count c)
               (length (objects-8 (cellmap g (r cc v) (if (= v c) c bg)) bg)))
             (define color-counts (map (lambda (c) (list c (color-count c))) fg-colors))
             (define max-h (max-of second color-counts))
             (define base (empty-grid max-h 5 bg))
             (reduce (lambda (gg cc)
                       (let* ((c (first cc))
                              (n (second cc))
                              (col (cond
                                     ((= c 5) 0)
                                     ((= c 2) 1)
                                     ((= c 8) 2)
                                     ((= c 9) 3)
                                     ((= c 6) 4)
                                     (else 0))))
                         (reduce (lambda (gg2 i) (set-cell gg2 (- (- max-h 1) i) col c))
                                 gg
                                 (range 0 n))))
                     base
                     color-counts)))))

racket_teaching.scope: Only these finite rivals and sampled demonstrations; no universal uniqueness claim.

      (let* ((entry (list-ref ordered col)) (color (first entry)) (n (second entry)))
        (reduce (lambda (acc i) (set-cell acc (- (- height 1) i) col color))
                out (range 0 n))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((colors (list 5 2 8 9 6))
         (records (map (lambda (c)
           (let ((masked (cellmap g (r cc v) (if (= v c) c 7)))
                 (positions (find-color g c)))
             (list c (length (objects-8 masked 7)) (length (objects masked 7))
                   (length positions)
                   (if (empty? positions) (* (rows g) (cols g))
                     (+ (* (first (first positions)) (cols g)) (second (first positions))))
                   (- 5 (length (member c colors)))))) colors))
         (ordered (filter (lambda (e) (> (second e) 0)) (sort-by records second)))
         (height (max-of (lambda (e) (second e)) records)))
    (reduce (lambda (out col)
      (let* ((e (list-ref ordered col)) (color (first e)) (n (second e)))
        (reduce (lambda (acc i) (set-cell acc (- (- height 1) i) col color)) out (range 0 n))))
      (empty-grid height 5 7) (range 0 (length ordered))))))
